title: RE live test results: UC-2 User logging in

environment.Client: Python 3 `urllib`, one request at a time

cases.title: Signing up creates the account and signs the student in
cases.requirement: FR-1 "Log in system with unique logins for users", UC-2 User logging in
cases.inputs: POST /api/auth/register with name "Name N", email "Temp-RE-1795843681-01@Cramberry.TEST " (mixed case, trailing space), password "Password12". Then GET /api/users/me with the returned token.
cases.expected: The account is created with the email stored in lower case and trimmed. A session token is returned and signs the student in. The password is stored as a hash, not as typed.
cases.actual: Register returned 201 with email 'temp-re-1795843681-01@cramberry.test' and a token of 64 characters. /api/users/me returned 200. Supabase has 1 students row and the stored hash starts 'pbkdf2_sha25...'.

checks.check: GET /api/users/me with the token -> 200 and the same student id
one students row with the lower-case email
password_hash is not the password and does not contain it
a sessions row for the token belongs to the student

cases.title: A weak password is refused and no account is created
cases.requirement: FR-1 "Log in system with unique logins for users", UC-2 User logging in
cases.inputs: POST /api/auth/register with name "Someone", email "temp-re-1795843681-02@cramberry.test", password "password" (8 letters, no number).
cases.expected: The sign-up is refused as invalid input and no account is stored.
cases.actual: Register returned 400 with 'Password must contain at least one letter and one number'. Supabase has 0 students rows for the email.

checks.check: no students row for the email

cases.title: An email that is already registered can't be used again, whatever its case
cases.requirement: FR-1 "Log in system with unique logins for users", UC-2 User logging in
cases.inputs: POST /api/auth/register with name "Name N", email "temp-re-1795843681-03@cramberry.test", password "Password12". Then again with name "Other", email "temp-re-1795843681-03@CRAMBERRY.test", password "Password34".
cases.expected: The second sign-up is refused as a conflict. Only the first account exists.
cases.actual: First register returned 201. Second returned 409 with 'An account with this email already exists'. Supabase has 1 students row for the email, named 'Name N'.

checks.check: second register with the same email in another case -> 409
still exactly one students row for the email
that row is the first account (name "Name N")

cases.title: The right email and password sign the student in
cases.requirement: FR-1 "Log in system with unique logins for users", UC-2 User logging in
cases.inputs: Sign up "temp-re-1795843681-04@cramberry.test" with password "Password12". Then POST /api/auth/login with the same email and password, and GET /api/users/me with the returned token.
cases.expected: Login succeeds, returns the student with that email and a session token.
cases.actual: Login returned 200 with email 'temp-re-1795843681-04@cramberry.test' and a token of 64 characters. /api/users/me returned 200, and Supabase has sessions row for the token.

checks.check: a sessions row for the login token belongs to the student

cases.title: A wrong password and an unknown email get the same answer
cases.requirement: FR-1 "Log in system with unique logins for users", UC-2 User logging in
cases.inputs: Sign up "temp-re-1795843681-05@cramberry.test" with password "Password12". Then POST /api/auth/login with that email and "Wrong1234", and with "temp-re-1795843681-05-nobody@cramberry.test" (no account) and "Password12".
cases.expected: Both logins are refused as unauthorized with the same message, so the app doesn't reveal which emails have accounts.
cases.actual: Wrong password returned 401 {'error': 'Email or password is incorrect'}. Unknown email returned 401 {'error': 'Email or password is incorrect'}.

checks.check: the unknown email has no students row
both responses have the same body

cases.title: After logging out, the session no longer works
cases.requirement: FR-1 "Log in system with unique logins for users", UC-2 User logging in
cases.inputs: Sign up "temp-re-1795843681-06@cramberry.test" with password "Password12". GET /api/users/me with its token, POST /api/auth/logout with the token, then GET /api/users/me with the same token again.
cases.expected: The session works until logout. After logout the same token is refused.
cases.actual: /api/users/me returned 200 before logout. Logout returned 204. /api/users/me then returned 401, and the sessions row was gone.

checks.check: GET /api/users/me with the same token after logout -> 401
sessions row is gone after logout

cases.title: Made-up tokens are refused, and a session expires after 7 days
cases.requirement: FR-1 "Log in system with unique logins for users", UC-2 User logging in
cases.inputs: Sign up "temp-re-1795843681-07@cramberry.test" with password "Password12". GET /api/users/me with token "not-a-token" and with "Authorization: Bearer " (empty token). This session's expires_at in the Supabase sessions table was set to 2026-11-28 05:30 UTC, as if it was created 7 days less 2 minutes ago, and GET /api/users/me was called. Then it was set to 2026-11-28 05:27 UTC, as if created 7 days and 1 minute ago, and GET /api/users/me was called again.
cases.expected: Made-up and empty tokens are refused. A session works until it is 7 days old and is refused after.
cases.actual: "not-a-token" returned 401 and the empty token returned 401. The new session's expiry was 10080 minutes after sign-up. Two minutes before expiry it returned 200, and one minute after it returned 401.

checks.check: GET /api/users/me with an empty bearer token -> 401
the new session's expires_at is 7 days (10080 minutes) after sign-up
session 2 minutes short of 7 days old -> 200
